$description: Hand-authored ledger of decisions made by the human owner. The only file allowed to turn a 'pending human approval' item into 'approved'. extraction/build_repo.py applies these records; extraction/verify_all.py accepts an approved item only when it matches a record here and the approver is not an agent. Agents must never add or edit records here on their own initiative: they transcribe the owner's words verbatim.
